info.description: Versioned API for durable capture, authentication, and note management.

get.summary: List captures by processing state and original client time
get.description: Orders by server receivedAt descending with capture ID as a stable tie-breaker. Date filters apply to clientCreatedAt as a half-open [from, to) interval.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive clientCreatedAt lower bound for the offline-safe capture timeline.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive clientCreatedAt upper bound for the offline-safe capture timeline.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The clientCaptureId from the request body. It must remain byte-identical across retries.

get.summary: Get the durable organization receipt for one capture

post.summary: Upload one photo or recording for a capture as raw bytes
post.description: The body is the file itself (a JPEG at most 1568 px on its long edge, or an AAC recording in an m4a container), at most 700,000 bytes. The attachment is sealed under the capture's key class and waits, unbound, until the capture that names it is created.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The client-generated attachment id. It must remain byte-identical across retries.

parameters.name: X-Unfiled-Capture-Id
parameters.description: The clientCaptureId this photo or recording belongs to.

parameters.name: X-Unfiled-Privacy
parameters.description: The capture's privacy mode; ai_assisted when omitted.

parameters.name: X-Unfiled-Width
parameters.description: Photo width in pixels. Required for image/jpeg uploads.

parameters.name: X-Unfiled-Height
parameters.description: Photo height in pixels. Required for image/jpeg uploads.

parameters.name: X-Unfiled-Duration-Ms
parameters.description: Recording length in milliseconds. Required for audio/mp4 uploads.

201.description: Attachment sealed and waiting for its capture
